configuration.purpose:
Verify frozen W27 using cosim in a new workspace. Run two complete butterfly transactions with finite-FIFO profiling and deadlock detection; measure actual latency and interval under a six-hour timeout. Require rtl_min_cycles=553171. Require rtl_max_cycles=564345.

Decision basis: WS-C2: all three HLS fold reports explicitly say yes(frp), II1. Compare two-frame changed-parameter RTL to F97 latency558758; the unchanged plan requires latency within plus/minus1 percent. HLS reports still estimate Conv3 valid/window-capture fanout8002, so independent routing remains necessary. The independent second transaction changes weights/biases and uses constant0.5 input; every pixel must equal104/256 exactly. The first remains E017-exact butterfly with unchanged border MSE.
